ar: كَوِّنْ لِىَ الْيَوْمَ نَصْرًا عَزَّ مَوْلَايَا
وَلْتَكْشِفِ الْحُجْبَ عَنِّى هَبْ لِىَ الْئَايَا
tr: kawwin liyal yawma nasran hazza mawlaayaa
wal takshifil hujba hannii hab liyal aayaa
bayts.fr: Crée pour moi aujourd'hui une victoire – glorieux est mon Seigneur ! – et ôte de moi les voiles ; accorde-moi les signes (prodigieux).
bayts.en: Bring about for me today a victory – mighty is my Lord! – and lift the veils from me; grant me the (wondrous) signs.
bayts.it: Crea per me oggi una vittoria – glorioso è il mio Signore! – e rimuovi da me i veli; donami i segni (prodigiosi).

ar: تَوَّابُ لِى اغْفِرْ ذُنُوبِى وَامْحُ كُلَّ لَغًى
عَنِّى وَكُنْ لِّىَ فِى دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَايَا
tr: tawwaabu lighfir zunuubii wamhu kulla laghan
hanni wa kun liya fii dunyaa wa ukhraayaa
bayts.fr: Ô Toi qui accueilles le repentir (At-Tawwāb), pardonne-moi mes péchés et efface de moi tout vain propos, et sois pour moi dans mon monde et dans mon Au-delà.
bayts.en: O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), forgive me my sins and erase from me every idle word, and be for me in my world and in my Hereafter.
bayts.it: O Tu che accogli il pentimento (At-Tawwāb), perdonami i miei peccati e cancella da me ogni vaniloquio, e sii per me nel mio mondo e nel mio Aldilà.

ar: بِكَوْنِكَ الْوَاحِدَ الْقَهَّارَ رُضْ لِىَ يَا
رَبِّى الْعِدَى وَلْتُخَلِّدْ فِيكَ بُشْرَا يَا
tr: bikawnikal waahidal qahhaara rud liya yaa
rabbil hidaa waltukhallid fiika bushraa yaa
bayts.fr: Par Ton être l'Unique, le Dominateur (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), dompte pour moi, ô mon Seigneur, les ennemis, et rends éternelle en Toi ma bonne nouvelle.
bayts.en: By Your being the One, the Subduer (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), tame the enemies for me, O my Lord, and make my glad tiding everlasting in You.
bayts.it: Per il Tuo essere l'Unico, il Dominatore (Al-Wāḥid al-Qahhār), doma per me, o mio Signore, i nemici, e rendi eterna in Te la mia buona novella.

ar: أَنْتَ الْإِلَاهُ الَّذِى تُعْلِى وَتَرْفَعُ مَنْ
قَدْ شِئْتَهُ فَلْتُطَيِّبْ فِيكَ مَحْيَا يَا
tr: antal ilaahul lazii tuhlii wa tarfahu man
qad shi-tahu faltutayyib fiika mah-yaa yaa
bayts.fr: Tu es le Dieu qui exalte et élève qui Il veut : rends donc bonne en Toi ma vie.
bayts.en: You are the God Who exalts and raises whom You will: so make my life good in You.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Dio che esalta ed eleva chi vuole: rendi dunque buona in Te la mia vita.

ar: لَكَ السَّمَا وَالْأَرَاضِى وَالْهَوَاءُ مَعًا
قِنِى أَذَى الْكُلِّ وَلْتُخْلِدْ مَزَايَا يَا
tr: lakas samaa wal araadii wal hawaa-u mahan
qinii azal kulli wal tukhlid mazaayaa yaa
bayts.fr: À Toi sont le ciel, les terres et l'air ensemble : préserve-moi du mal de tout, et rends éternels mes privilèges.
bayts.en: Yours are the sky, the earths and the air together: guard me from the harm of all, and make my distinctions everlasting.
bayts.it: Tuoi sono il cielo, le terre e l'aria insieme: preservami dal danno di tutto, e rendi eterni i miei privilegi.

ar: لَكَ السَّلَاطِينُ طُرًّا وَالْمُلُوكُ كَذَا
أَتْبَا عُهُمْ لِىَ رُضْهُمْ قَبْلَ لُقْيَا يَا
tr: lakas salaatiinu turran wal muluuku kazaa
atbaa huhum liya rudhum qabla luq-yaa yaa
bayts.fr: À Toi sont tous les sultans, et de même les rois et leurs suivants : dompte-les pour moi avant ma rencontre (avec eux).
bayts.en: Yours are all the sultans, and likewise the kings and their followers: tame them for me before my meeting (with them).
bayts.it: Tuoi sono tutti i sultani, e così i re e i loro seguaci: domali per me prima del mio incontro (con loro).

ar: هَبْ لِى تَلَازُمَ مَا تَرْضَاهُ مِنْ عَمَلٍ
وَمِنْ مَّقَالٍ وَعَقْدٍ عِنْدَ مَغْنَا يَا
tr: hab lii talaazuma maa tardaahu min hamalin
wa min maqaalin wa haqdin hinda  maghnaa yaa
bayts.fr: Accorde-moi la constance dans ce que Tu agrées d'œuvre, de parole et de croyance, en ma demeure.
bayts.en: Grant me constancy in what You are pleased with of deed, word and creed, at my dwelling.
bayts.it: Donami la costanza in ciò che gradisci di opera, di parola e di credo, presso la mia dimora.

ar: لَكَ الْبَرَايَا جَمِيعًا وَالْبِلَا دُفَكُنْ
لِّى يَاإِلَاهِىَ فِى دَارِى وَطُوبَا يَا
tr: lakal baraayaa jamiihan wal bilaa dufakun
lii yaa ilaahiya fii daarii wa tuubaa yaa
bayts.fr: À Toi sont toutes les créatures et les pays : sois donc pour moi, ô mon Dieu, dans ma demeure et dans ma Ṭūbā (Touba).
bayts.en: Yours are all creatures and the lands: so be for me, O my God, in my abode and in my Ṭūbā (Touba).
bayts.it: Tue sono tutte le creature e i paesi: sii dunque per me, o mio Dio, nella mia dimora e nella mia Ṭūbā (Touba).

ar: أُنْصُرْ جَنَابِى وَحِصْنِى لِى أَطِبْ عُمُرِى
بِمَا تُحِبُّ وَأَحْسِنْ فِيكَ تَقْوَا يَا
tr: unsur janaabii wa hisnii lii atib humurii
bimaa tuhibbu wa ahsin fiika taqwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Secours mon territoire et ma forteresse ; rends bonne pour moi ma vie par ce que Tu aimes, et parfais en Toi ma crainte de Dieu.
bayts.en: Aid my precinct and my fortress; make my life good for me with what You love, and perfect in You my God-fearing.
bayts.it: Soccorri il mio territorio e la mia fortezza; rendi buona per me la mia vita con ciò che ami, e perfeziona in Te il mio timor di Dio.

ar: غَنِيتُ بِالْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ عَنْ زُمَرٍ
وَكَانَ لِى وَنَفَى فَقْرِ وَبَلْوَا يَا
tr: ghaniitu bil waahidil qahhaari han zumarin
wa kaana lii wa nafaa faqri wa balwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Je me suis enrichi de l'Unique, le Dominateur, (me rendant indépendant) des cohortes ; Il a été pour moi et a repoussé ma pauvreté et mon épreuve.
bayts.en: I have been enriched by the One, the Subduer, (made free) of the throngs; He has been for me and repelled my poverty and my trial.
bayts.it: Mi sono arricchito dell'Unico, il Dominatore, (rendendomi indipendente) dalle schiere; Egli è stato per me e ha respinto la mia povertà e la mia prova.

ar: لَهُ تَوَجَّهْتُ ذَا شُكْرٍ لَّهُ أَبَدًا
وَأَرْتَجِى مِنْهُ مَالَمْ يَحْوِ شَرْوَا يَا
tr: lahu tawajjahtu zaa shukrin lahu abadan
wa artajii minhu maa lam yahwi sharwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Vers Lui je me suis tourné, plein de gratitude envers Lui pour toujours, et j'espère de Lui ce que nul de mes pareils n'a obtenu.
bayts.en: To Him I have turned, full of gratitude to Him for ever, and I hope from Him what none of my peers has attained.
bayts.it: A Lui mi sono volto, colmo di gratitudine verso di Lui per sempre, e spero da Lui ciò che nessun mio pari ha ottenuto.

ar: بِكَوْنِكَ الْقَادِرَ الْقَهَّارَ مُقْتَدِرًا
أَرْجُوا تَلَازُمَ مَآ أَهْوَى بِمَنْجَا يَا
tr: bikawnikal qaadiral qahhaara muqtadiran
arjuu talaazuma maa ahwaa bimanjaa yaa
bayts.fr: Par Ton être le Puissant, le Dominateur, l'Omnipotent, j'espère la constance de ce que j'aime, au lieu de mon salut.
bayts.en: By Your being the Powerful, the Subduer, the All-Capable, I hope for the constancy of what I love, in the place of my safety.
bayts.it: Per il Tuo essere il Potente, il Dominatore, l'Onnipotente, spero la costanza di ciò che amo, nel luogo della mia salvezza.

ar: نَاجَيْتُهُ رَاجِيًا أَنْ لَّا يُخَيِّبَنِى
وَأَنْ يُّوَجِّهَ لِى مَا فَاقَ مَنْ جَايَا
tr: naajaytuhu raajiyan an laa yukhayyibanii
wa an yuwajjiha lii maa faaqa man jaayaa
bayts.fr: Je L'ai invoqué intimement, espérant qu'Il ne me déçoive pas et qu'Il tourne vers moi ce qui dépasse mon salut.
bayts.en: I have called on Him intimately, hoping He will not disappoint me and will turn toward me what surpasses my safety.
bayts.it: L'ho invocato in intimità, sperando che non mi deluda e che rivolga a me ciò che supera la mia salvezza.

ar: نَوَيْتُ إِرْضَاءَهُ إِرْضَاءَ مَنْ صَلَحُوا
بَعْدَ انْصِرَا فِى إِلَى أَهْلِى وَسُكْنَا يَا
tr: nawaytu irdaa-ahu irdaa-a man salahuu
bahdan siraa fii ilaa ahlii wa suknaa yaa
bayts.fr: J'ai formé l'intention de Le satisfaire comme Le satisfont ceux qui sont pieux, après mon retour auprès de ma famille et de ma demeure.
bayts.en: I have resolved to please Him as those who are righteous please Him, after my return to my family and my dwelling.
bayts.it: Ho fatto intenzione di compiacerLo come Lo compiacciono coloro che sono pii, dopo il mio ritorno presso la mia famiglia e la mia dimora.

ar: أَنْتَ الْقَدِيرُ الَّذِى أَرْجُوا بِقُدْرَتِهِ
حَوْزِ السِّيَادَةَ زِدْنِى بَعْدَ حُسْنَا يَا
tr: antal qadiirul lazii arjuu biqudratihi
hawzis siyaadata zidnii bahda husnaa yaa
bayts.fr: Tu es l'Omnipotent (Al-Qadīr) par la puissance de Qui j'espère obtenir la seigneurie : accrois-moi au-delà de mon bien.
bayts.en: You are the All-Powerful (Al-Qadīr) by Whose power I hope to attain mastery: increase me beyond my good.
bayts.it: Tu sei l'Onnipotente (Al-Qadīr) per la cui potenza spero di conseguire la signoria: accrescimi oltre il mio bene.

ar: نَبَذْثُ مَا كَانَ عِنْدِى سُقْ بِكَوْنِكَ لِى
دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى الَّذِى تَرْضَى بِرُغْبَا يَا
tr: nabazsu maa kaana hindii suq bikawnika lii
dunyaa wa ukhral lazii tardaa birughbaa yaa
bayts.fr: J'ai rejeté ce que j'avais : amène-moi, par Ton être (Dieu), en ce monde et dans l'Autre, ce que Tu agrées selon mon désir.
bayts.en: I have cast away what I had: lead to me, by Your being (God), in this world and the Other, what You are pleased with according to my desire.
bayts.it: Ho rigettato ciò che avevo: conduci a me, per il Tuo essere (Dio), nel mondo e nell'Altro, ciò che gradisci secondo il mio desiderio.

ar: أَطِلْ مُكُوثِى بِطَاعَاتٍ مُّخَلَّصَةٍ
وَاكْتُبْ بِّقَهْرِكَ يَارَبِّى غُلُبَّا يَا
tr: atil mukuusii bitaahaatin mukhallasatin
waktub biqahrika yaa rabbii ghulubba yaa
bayts.fr: Prolonge mon séjour par des actes d'obéissance rendus purs, et décrète par Ta domination, ô mon Seigneur, ma victoire.
bayts.en: Prolong my sojourn with acts of obedience made pure, and decree by Your dominion, O my Lord, my victory.
bayts.it: Prolunga la mia permanenza con atti di obbedienza resi puri, e decreta con il Tuo dominio, o mio Signore, la mia vittoria.

ar: وَجِّهْ بِعِزِّكَ لِى عِزًّا أَكُونُ بِهِ
عَبْدًا عَزِيزًا وَخَلِّدْ عَنْكَ عُتْبَا يَا
tr: wajjih bihizzika lii hizzan akuunu bihi
habdan haziizan wa khallid hanka hutbaa yaa
bayts.fr: Tourne vers moi, par Ta puissance, une puissance par laquelle je sois un serviteur glorieux, et rends éternelle de Ta part ma faveur.
bayts.en: Turn toward me, by Your might, a might through which I may be a glorious servant, and make my favour from You everlasting.
bayts.it: Rivolgi a me, per la Tua potenza, una potenza per la quale io sia un servo glorioso, e rendi eterno da parte Tua il mio favore.

ar: رَبَّيْتَنِى بِالْعِدَى رُضْ لِى الْجَمِيعَ وَقُدْ
نِى لِلْأَحِبَّةِ وَاحْمَدْ رَبِّ مَسْعَا يَا
tr: rabbaytanii bil hidaa rud lil jamiiha wa qud
nii lil a-hibbati wahmad rabbi mas-haa yaa
bayts.fr: Tu m'as éduqué par les ennemis : dompte-les tous pour moi, conduis-moi vers les bien-aimés, et loue, Seigneur, mon effort.
bayts.en: You have trained me through enemies: tame them all for me, lead me to the beloved ones, and praise, Lord, my striving.
bayts.it: Mi hai educato per mezzo dei nemici: domali tutti per me, conducimi agli amati, e loda, Signore, il mio sforzo.

ar: سُقْ سَرْمَدًا لِىَ مَا فَاقَ الْمُنَى كَرَمًا
وَاجْعَلْ كِتَابَكَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ مَرْعَا يَا
tr: suq sarmadan liya maa faaqal munaa karaman
wajhal kitaabaka fid daarayni marhaa yaa
bayts.fr: Amène-moi pour toujours ce qui dépasse les souhaits, par générosité, et fais de Ton Livre, dans les deux Demeures, mon pâturage.
bayts.en: Lead to me for ever what surpasses wishes, out of generosity, and make Your Book, in the two Abodes, my pasture.
bayts.it: Conduci a me per sempre ciò che supera i desideri, per generosità, e rendi il Tuo Libro, nelle due Dimore, il mio pascolo.

ar: لِى سُقْ دَوَامًا كُئُوسَ الْقَوْمِ تَرْوِيَةً
وَلْتَسْقِنِى وَلْتُعَظِّمْ رَبِّ سُقْيَا يَا
tr: lii suq dawaaman ku-uusal qawmi tarwiyatan
waltasqinii waltuhazzim rabbi suq-yaa yaa
bayts.fr: Amène-moi toujours les coupes des gens (spirituels), pour me désaltérer ; abreuve-moi et rends grand, Seigneur, mon abreuvement.
bayts.en: Lead to me always the cups of the (spiritual) folk, to quench me; give me to drink and make great, Lord, my draught.
bayts.it: Conduci a me sempre le coppe della gente (spirituale), per dissetarmi; abbeverami e rendi grande, Signore, il mio abbeveramento.

ar: يَاذَا الْبَقَاءِ الَّذِى أَبْقَيْتَ لِى عُمُرِى
عَبْدًا خَدِيمًا سَعِيدًا وَاحْمِ بُغْيَا يَا
tr: yaa zaal baqaa-il lazii abqayta lii humurii
habdan khadiiman sahiidan wahmi bugh-yaa yaa
bayts.fr: Ô Maître de la permanence, qui as fait durer pour moi ma vie, (me rendant) serviteur, servant, heureux : protège mon désir.
bayts.en: O Lord of permanence, Who made my life endure for me, (making me) a servant, a server, blessed: protect my desire.
bayts.it: O Signore della permanenza, che hai fatto durare per me la mia vita, (rendendomi) servo, servitore, felice: proteggi il mio desiderio.

ar: إِلَيْكَ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِى دَاعِيًا مَّلِكِى
فَلِى اسْتَجِبْ كَرَمًا يَارَبِّ دَعْوَا يَا
tr: ilayka wajjahtu wajhii daahiyan malikii
falis tajib karaman yaa rabbi dahwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Vers Toi j'ai tourné mon visage, T'invoquant, ô mon Roi : exauce donc, par générosité, ô Seigneur, mon invocation.
bayts.en: To You I have turned my face, calling on You, O my King: so answer, out of generosity, O Lord, my supplication.
bayts.it: A Te ho rivolto il mio volto, invocandoTi, o mio Re: esaudisci dunque, per generosità, o Signore, la mia invocazione.

ar: نَجَّيْتَنِى فَلْتَزِدْنِى رَبِّ تَنْجِيَةً
وَلْتَحْمِنِى وَاحْمِ مَا يَحْوِيهِ مَثْوَا يَا
tr: najjaytanii faltazidnii rabbi tanjiyatan
wal tahminii wahmi maa yahwiihi maswaa yaa
bayts.fr: Tu m'as sauvé : accrois-moi donc, Seigneur, le salut ; protège-moi et protège ce que contient ma demeure.
bayts.en: You have saved me: so increase me, Lord, in salvation; protect me and protect what my dwelling holds.
bayts.it: Mi hai salvato: accrescimi dunque, Signore, la salvezza; proteggimi e proteggi ciò che contiene la mia dimora.

ar: نَجَّيْتَنِى أَمْسِ مِنْ عَوْدِى إِلَى سِلَعٍ
فَالْيَوْمَ كُنْ لِى وَعَظِّمْ مِّنْكَ جَدْوَايَا
tr: najjaytanii amsi min hawdii ilaa silahin
fal yawma kun lii wa hazzim minka jadwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Tu m'as sauvé hier de mon retour aux marchandises (du monde) : aujourd'hui donc sois pour moi et rends grand de Ta part mon bienfait.
bayts.en: You saved me yesterday from my return to (worldly) merchandise: so today be for me and make great from You my benefit.
bayts.it: Mi hai salvato ieri dal mio ritorno alle mercanzie (del mondo): oggi dunque sii per me e rendi grande da parte Tua il mio beneficio.

ar: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى أَبْغِى حِمَايَتَهُ
فَكُنْ حَفِيظِى وَزِدْ يَارَبِّ تَقْوَا يَا
tr: antal hafiizul lazii abghii himaayatahu
fakun hafiizii wa zid yaa rabbi taqwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Tu es le Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ) dont je recherche la protection : sois donc mon Gardien et accrois, ô Seigneur, ma crainte de Dieu.
bayts.en: You are the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ) Whose protection I seek: so be my Preserver and increase, O Lord, my God-fearing.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ) di cui cerco la protezione: sii dunque mio Custode e accresci, o Signore, il mio timor di Dio.

ar: لَكَ انْصِرَا فِىَ كَسْبًا قُدْزِمَامِىَ يَا
رَبِّ وَهَبْ لِىَ حَمْدًا رَّبِّ مَسْرَا يَا
tr: lakan siraa fiya kasban qudzimaamiya yaa
rabbi wa hab liya hamdan rabbi masraa yaa
bayts.fr: À Toi est mon retour comme gain : conduis mes rênes, ô Seigneur, et accorde-moi louange, Seigneur, de mon voyage nocturne.
bayts.en: To You is my turning as gain: lead my reins, O Lord, and grant me praise, Lord, for my night journey.
bayts.it: A Te è il mio volgermi come guadagno: conduci le mie redini, o Signore, e donami lode, Signore, del mio viaggio notturno.

ar: لَكَارْتِحَا لِىَ ذَا جَرْىٍ فَسُقْ غَرَضِى
لِىَ عَاجِلًا ءَآئِبًا وَلْتَحْمِ مَجْرَا يَا
tr: lakartihaa liya zaa jar-yin fasuq gharadii
liya haajilan aa-iban wal tahmi majraa yaa
bayts.fr: À Toi est mon départ, désormais en cours : amène-moi bientôt mon but, (me faisant) revenir, et protège mon cheminement.
bayts.en: To You is my departure, now under way: lead my aim to me soon, (bringing me) back, and protect my course.
bayts.it: A Te è la mia partenza, ora in corso: conduci a me presto il mio scopo, (facendomi) ritornare, e proteggi il mio cammino.

ar: هَبْ لِى بِكَوْنِكَ وَهَّابَا بِلَا سَبَبٍ
مَّا فَاقَ ظَنِّىَ وَمْلَا رَبِّ مَهْدَا يَا
tr: hab lii bikawnika wahhaabaa bilaa sababin
maa faaqa zanniya wamlaa rabbi mahdaa yaa
bayts.fr: Accorde-moi, par Ton être le Donateur (Al-Wahhāb) sans cause, ce qui dépasse mon attente, et remplis, Seigneur, ma couche.
bayts.en: Grant me, by Your being the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb) without cause, what surpasses my expectation, and fill, Lord, my resting-place.
bayts.it: Donami, per il Tuo essere il Donatore (Al-Wahhāb) senza causa, ciò che supera la mia attesa, e riempi, Signore, il mio giaciglio.

ar: قُدْ ذَا بِلُطْقٍ وَجُودٍ وَاكْفِنِى زَلَلًا
لَّكَ انْتِهَاءِى إِلَاهِى مِنْكَ مَبْدَا يَا
tr: qud zaa bilutqin wa juudin wakfinii zalalan
lakan tihaa-ii ilaahii minka mabdaa yaa
bayts.fr: Conduis cela avec bienveillance et générosité, et préserve-moi des faux pas : à Toi est mon terme, mon Dieu, de Toi mon commencement.
bayts.en: Lead this with kindness and generosity, and spare me slips: to You is my end, my God, from You my beginning.
bayts.it: Conduci ciò con benevolenza e generosità, e preservami dai passi falsi: a Te è il mio termine, mio Dio, da Te il mio principio.

ar: وَجَّهْتُ فِى السَّبْتِ وَجْهِى لَكَ فِى رَجَبٍ
وَفِى الثُّلَاثَاءِ فِى شَعْبَانَ مَلْجَا يَا
tr: wajjahtu fis sabti wajhii laka fii rajabin
wa fis sulaasaa-i fii shahbaana maljaa yaa
bayts.fr: J'ai tourné mon visage vers Toi un samedi, en Rajab, et un mardi, en Shaʿbān, (vers) mon refuge.
bayts.en: I turned my face to You on a Saturday, in Rajab, and on a Tuesday, in Shaʿbān, (toward) my refuge.
bayts.it: Ho rivolto il mio volto a Te di sabato, in Rajab, e di martedì, in Shaʿbān, (verso) il mio rifugio.

ar: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَى سَنَدِى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَبِهِ قُدْنِى لِأَرْجَا يَا
tr: yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halaa sanadii
muhammadin wa bihi qudnii li-arjaa yaa
bayts.fr: Ô Seigneur, bénis avec le salut de paix mon appui, Muḥammad, et par lui conduis-moi vers mes espérances.
bayts.en: O Lord, bless with peace my support, Muḥammad, and through him lead me to my hopes.
bayts.it: O Signore, benedici con il saluto di pace il mio sostegno, Muḥammad, e per mezzo di lui conducimi alle mie speranze.

ar: يَارَبِّ صَلِّ بِتَسْلِيمٍ عَلَيْهِ بِلَا
عَدٍّ مَّعَ الْئَالِ وَالْأَصْحَابِ مَنْجَا يَا
tr: yaa rabbi salli bitasliimin halayhi bilaa
haddin mahal aali wal as-haabi manjaa yaa
bayts.fr: Ô Seigneur, bénis-le avec le salut de paix sans nombre, avec la Famille et les Compagnons, mon salut.
bayts.en: O Lord, bless him with peace beyond number, with the Family and the Companions, my salvation.
bayts.it: O Signore, benedicilo con il saluto di pace senza numero, con la Famiglia e i Compagni, mia salvezza.

ar: عَلَيْهِ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ بِالْجَمِيعِ وَكُنْ
مُّنَوِّرًا بِىَ أَزْمَانِى وَأَنْجَا يَا
tr: halayhi salli wa sallim bil jamiihi wa kun
munawwiraa biya azmaanii wa anjaa yaa
bayts.fr: Sur lui répands bénédiction et paix, avec tous, et sois Celui qui par moi illumine mes temps et mes lieux de salut.
bayts.en: Upon him pour blessing and peace, with all, and be the One Who through me illumines my times and my places of safety.
bayts.it: Su di lui effondi benedizione e pace, insieme a tutti, e sii Colui che per mezzo mio illumina i miei tempi e i miei luoghi di salvezza.

ar: زِدْنِى عُلُومًا بِكَشْقٍ لَّا يُفَارِقُنِى
يَامَنْ لَّهُ أَشْتَكِى وَلْتُشْكِ شَكْوَا يَا
tr: zidnii huluuman bikashqin laa yufaariqunii
yaa man lahu ashtakii waltushki shakwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Accrois-moi en sciences par un dévoilement qui ne me quitte pas, ô Toi auprès de Qui je me plains : ôte la cause de ma plainte.
bayts.en: Increase me in sciences with an unveiling that never leaves me, O You to Whom I complain: remove the cause of my complaint.
bayts.it: Accrescimi in scienze con un disvelamento che non mi abbandoni, o Tu al Quale mi lamento: togli la causa del mio lamento.

ar: يَاخَيْرَ مُغْنٍ قَضَا حَاجِى بِلَا كُلَفٍ
يَامَنْ بِكَوْنِكَ لِى فَارَقْتُ بَلْوَا يَا
tr: yaa khayra mughnin qadaa haajii bilaa kulafin
yaa man bikawnika lii faaraqtu balwaa yaa
bayts.fr: Ô meilleur Enrichisseur, qui as satisfait mes besoins sans charges, ô Toi par l'être de Qui pour moi je me suis séparé de mon épreuve.
bayts.en: O best Enricher, Who fulfilled my needs without burdens, O You through Whose being for me I parted from my trial.
bayts.it: O migliore Arricchitore, che hai soddisfatto i miei bisogni senza oneri, o Tu per il cui essere per me mi sono separato dalla mia prova.

ar: زِنْتُ الْقَصَاءِدَ فِيْكُمْ شَاكِرًا لَّكُمُ
بِهَا بِكُمْ وَاجَهُواْ لِى الْكَشْفَ وَالْئَايَا
tr: zintul qasaa-ida fiykum shaakiran lakumu
bihaa bikum waajahuu lil kashfa wal aayaa
bayts.fr: J'ai orné les poèmes pour vous, en vous remerciant : par eux et par vous ils m'ont apporté le dévoilement et les signes.
bayts.en: I have adorned the poems for you, thanking you: through them and through you they brought me unveiling and signs.
bayts.it: Ho adornato i poemi per voi, ringraziandovi: per mezzo di essi e per mezzo vostro mi hanno recato il disvelamento e i segni.
